
```{r}
cor(prelim)
# use 0.26 - 0.68 as range of correlation in R
```

```{r}
# Omnibus tests
full_cvlt_mod <- lm(CVLT_CNG3 ~ IL_6 + MCP_1, data = prelim)
summary(full_cvlt_mod) # p = 0.198

full_cort_mod <- lm(CORT_CNG3 ~ IL_6 + MCP_1, data = prelim)
summary(full_cort_mod) # p = 0.00014

# Individual tests for cort model
cort_mod_il6 <- lm(CORT_CNG3 ~ IL_6 , data = prelim)
summary(cort_mod_il6) # p < 0.001

cort_mod_mcp1 <- lm(CORT_CNG3 ~ MCP_1 , data = prelim)
summary(cort_mod_mcp1) # p < 0.001
```


# Aim 1 Power

```{r}
omnibus_power_sweep <- function(n = 175, p = 2, alpha = 0.025,
                        r_range = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.1)){
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(r in r_range){
    
    pwr <- mlrF.overall(N = n, p = p, Rsq = r^2, alpha = alpha)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        r = r,
        pwr = pwr
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

omnibus_power_sweep()
```
